result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there is one prominent broken restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section and a couple of minor horizontal-clipping/layout concerns.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant/food photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or asset loading, add a retry/error state, and use a branded fallback image rather than a generic broken-image icon.

issues.description: The right edge of the category chip row is cut off, with only part of the next chip visible after 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional for horizontal scrolling, but add a clearer fade/edge affordance or ensure partially visible chips look deliberately scrollable rather than accidentally clipped.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you', the third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the screen edge and its name/delivery text are cut off.
issues.suggestion: If horizontal scrolling is intended, keep consistent card peek width and text truncation; otherwise adjust card spacing so content is not awkwardly cropped.
